title: MethScope: ultra-fast analysis of sparse DNA methylomes via Most Recurrent Methylation Pattern encoding
description: Pure-C command-line tool for cell-type classification, mini-bulk and spatial deconvolution, and genome-wide upscaling of sparse DNA methylomes via Most Recurrent Methylation Pattern (MRMP) encoding. Documentation: https://zhou-lab.github.io/methscope-cli/. Pretrained models: https://huggingface.co/zhou-lab/methscope. License: available to academic and non-profit institutions for research purposes under the 2-Clause BSD License; commercial use requires a license from Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (zhouw3@chop.edu). See LICENSE. The GitHub source archive omits the YAME submodule; the release tarball methscope-cli-<version>.tar.gz on the GitHub release includes it.
